title: LANG-2 fonts pair html:lang(vi) body of a template's language-fonts.css with body of its other stylesheets
steps: S1: Run apps/tracy-web/test/template-customization-question-readiness-t3-stylesheets.test.mjs (JA Sensei language-fonts.css and offline.css, JA Mood stylesheets).
expect: S1: every test passes: html:lang(vi) body has the selector of body in offline.css, html:lang(vi) body h1 reads h1, and a scope inside a selector stays.
evidence: 12/10/2026: JA Donate, Mood, Nova, Sensei and Space with css/language-fonts.css failed LANG-2 because bareSelector stripped only one leading scope (measured by the Joomla agent); whole gallery before/after: no change
fence: The font declaration reader, on stylesheets from the JA Sensei source
